name: alimi-demo
description: alimi Policy Pack demo: a clickable sample company on static pages. Brand tokens, policies, controls and checks come from the repo at build time.

scripts.scan: rm -rf .scan && alimi-scan m365 --snapshot data/snapshot.json --no-dns -o .scan -q && mv .scan/m365-*.findings.json data/scan.json && rm -rf .scan && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),f='data/scan.json';fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').trimEnd()+'\n')"
